script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: “Same size” goes beyond the text. The servants ask for an army like the one lost, specifying horse for horse and chariot for chariot, but do not specify the total number of soldiers.
“He doesn't push back at all” adds a detail the text does not give. It says he approves the plan and acts accordingly.
“No arguing, no second guessing” adds unreported behavior and thoughts. The text says Ben-hadad approved and acted on the plan.
“Small valley would be the Israelite side” suggests the Israelites camped in a small valley. The text compares them to two small flocks of goats but gives no such location.
The explanation is flat and repeats that the countryside is full of Arameans without adding much personality to the contrast.
The text does not say Ben-hadad fled after the wall fell. The joke also says Papa spent years hiding in the drawer, though he was placed there and forgotten.
The punchline jokes about losing an army immediately after a passage describing the deaths of soldiers.
“The men stay put” is not established by the text. They respond to Ahab, who then tells them to go and get Ben-hadad.
The text says Ben-hadad came up into Ahab's chariot, not that he sat next to him.
“Ben-hadad walks out free” adds how he left. The text says Ahab released him and sent him away.
The explanation is generic and offers little of Papa's personality in a moment that could accommodate a light line.
“He doesn't let the prophet go free” asserts an outcome the text does not state. Ahab pronounces judgment on the account the prophet has given him.
